# List issues — `redmine_list_issues`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_read-only_

Search and filter issues across one or all projects — the primary entry point for "what's on the board". Supports status/assignee/tracker/date/custom-field filters, saved queries, sorting, and pagination.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project_id` | string | no | Project id or identifier slug to scope to, e.g. "42" or "website". |
| `status_id` | string | no | Status filter. A status id, or a shortcut: "open" (any open status), "closed" (any closed status), or "*" (any status). Defaults to open issues. |
| `assigned_to_id` | string | no | Assignee user id, or "me" for the API key's own user. |
| `tracker_id` | string | no | Tracker id, e.g. "1" for Bug. |
| `author_id` | string | no | Author (reporter) user id, or "me". |
| `fixed_version_id` | string | no | Target version (milestone) id. |
| `category_id` | string | no | Issue category id. |
| `subject` | string | no | Filter by subject text (substring match). |
| `created_on` | string | no | Creation-date filter. Accepts Redmine operators, e.g. ">=2024-01-01", "<=2024-12-31", or "><2024-01-01\|2024-06-30" for a range. |
| `updated_on` | string | no | Last-updated-date filter; same operator grammar as created_on. |
| `due_date` | string | no | Due-date filter; same operator grammar as created_on. |
| `query_id` | integer | no | Run a saved query by its numeric id. |
| `custom_fields` | object (map) | no | Custom-field filters keyed by field id, e.g. { "5": "urgent" } (exact match). Only fields enabled as a filter in Redmine apply; others are silently ignored. |
| `sort` | string | no | Sort column, optionally with ":desc", e.g. "priority:desc,updated_on". |
| `include` | `attachments` \| `relations`[] | no | Associations to expand on each issue: "attachments" and/or "relations". |
| `offset` | integer | no | Pagination offset (skip N issues). |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of issues to return (Redmine caps at 100). |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_list_issues",
  "arguments": {
    "project_id": "42"
  }
}
```
